paragraphs: A student of R' Akiva. In Shabbat 68b and in the Sifra, at the beginning of Metzora, they said: “Thus did Munbaz reason before R' Akiva, and R' Akiva said to him, 'I add to your words.'”[^1]

notes.text: סח: gives 68b; ר״פ מצורע is the beginning of the Sifra Metzora section, without a fresh edition check. דן is reasoned/argued, not merely expounded. All three Akiva occurrences have abbreviated titles only and remain R'; the repeated ר״ע is locally the same name, not evidence of a full title. Both sources, student relation and reply remain Hyman’s report. Munbaz has no separate title or royal identity added.
